title: job event: done
description: Terminal frame of a job. The bench releases its job lock as soon as this frame is sent (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:3356-3366). May arrive before the hub has finished sending an image (refusal). A job channel that closes without done is reported by the hub as FLASH_FAILED with data.result_lost (src/alb/remote/flash.py:956-967).

rc.description: Tool exit code; -1 when the tool did not run or was killed.

stdout.description: Last 64 KiB of the tool's stdout.

stderr.description: Last 64 KiB of the tool's stderr.

data.description: Structured result of builtin ops (usb-list, log-tail, tool-run, tool-list, agent-update, edl-*). Shape differs per op and is not described in v1.
